chung.Syllabus Name: Front desk and receptionist skills_Nghiệp vụ tiền sảnh, lễ tân
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description:
Main objective: The course aims for equipping students hands-on experiences as real front office employees through handle variety of tasks in each position under front office department.

Description: Taking school laboratory with standard of 3 star hotel as a real working environment, Front office management 2 focuses particularly on training practical skills in front office deparment for students. The course allows student to experience detailed daily tasks of each position cross front office department such as receptionist, phone operator, cashier, night auditor…etc…With various day to day situation to deal and to handle, learner will be familiar with front office operations enhancing competitive advantage on the hotel job market.

-Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work

- Facility and equipment requirement : Depending on the training condition of each campus, the course will be implemented in school lab designed up to 4-5* hotel standard, real hotel or other places, which fully met with requirements.

Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Professional grooming

- Strongly communication and teamworking.

Role Play in lab and presentation' submission via email or anycourse supporting platfrom.

Group Assignment Suggestion:

Students will be seperated into the team of 5 to10 people. The team is expected to operate the front office division as the standard of 5 star hotels. The teams will select the hotel brand by their own based on history, design concept, room categories, favorite service style. The groups will divide members themselves to ensure each menber cover a role in the front office division from Fom to cashier, bell, receptionist…. On the day of performance, the team will manage unexpected situations given by lecturers or other group students altogether. Before practical day, the teams must submit a presentation with the content of hotel name, information, characteristics,philosophy, design, service style and team members.

Grading is based on performance in class (70%), check point quality (10%), ppts presentation (20%).

The performance should be filmed for review.

- To create a disciplined environment and maintain a professional interface as a internationl hotelier standard, It is manatory for student to follow two indispensible aspects in service industry as a grading criteria, which are attitude and professional grooming.

Students must comply perfectly with school & class regulation such as grooming, uniform, personal hygiene and attitude coming to demo front office with details the following:

1. Attitude

- Work seriously and attentively

- Respect and protect school asset.

- Strongly communication and teamworking.

- Be on time with professional grooming

2. Dress & Grooming Code

For Boys:

- School uniform or personal clothes including Black Trousers, White Shirt Full Sleeves, Tie or Vest

(Entering class with Jeans & T shirts is not allowed)

-The sleeves of a full sleeve shirt should never be rolled up.

- Formal shoes (black) and black socks.

- No Ear rings, bangles except for religious purpose are allowed in the class.

- Any kind of hair dye and spike hair style is strictly prohibited.

- In winter black coat and black pullover.

- Wearing of Name tag is mandatory for all students during class

For Girls:

- School Uniform or personal clothes such as Black Trousers, White Shirt Full Sleeves, Vest or Ao dai

(Entering class with Jeans & T shirts is not allowed)

- The sleeves of shirt should never be rolled up.

- Formal black shoes with ankle high socks.

- No visible painting including mehendi and tattoos.

- Only one ear ring/top.

- In winter black coat and black cardigan without collar are allowed.

- Hair should be tied in Bun shape during class.

Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots

Attendance check at any time during course

Practical Test Suggestion:

-PT1: Using computer and PMS on lab to handle situations according to the examination request.

-PT2: Each students select randomly a procedure of chapter 2,3,4. After selection each student will be grouped into teams of 8-10 people (arranged randomly) and perform their own procedure at the same time on lab. Grade will be scored individually based on the proficiency and professionalism of the procedure that the student has performed.

-PT3: Each students select randomly a procedure of chapter 5,6,7. After selection each student will be grouped into teams of 8-10 people (arranged randomly) and perform their own procedure at the same time on lab. Grade will be scored individually based on the proficiency and professionalism of the procedure that the student has performed.

Students ramdomly select a procedure to take the test.

Practical Evaluation form is required
The exam questions must be updated or different at least 70% to the previous ones.
